headline: Paper reports a game-based method for mitigating agent deception
summary: A Nov 9 arXiv paper formulates agent deception mitigation as an extensive-form game in which a monitor inspects interaction trajectories and a verifier checks its claims. The authors prove equilibrium existence for finite games and state conditions under which equilibrium behavior is faithful. They report lower deception and higher compliant task success in Agentic Role-Playing, SearchQA, and WebShop experiments with Gemma3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B/8B. These are controlled paper-reported results, not independently reproduced or evidence of deployment performance.
